dic_postprocess.analysisRun.summarizeStrain

Postprocess ops helper. Expected caller: labkit_DICPostprocess_app.

Syntax

function T = summarizeStrain(strain, mask)

Description

Inputs are strain struct and logical summary mask. Output is ROI strain summary table with Metric, EXX, and EYY columns. Side effects: none.
